_: LeadingLight's keyboard shortcuts, in Shipyard's shape (vendor/shipyard/app/src/lib/shortcuts.ts reads it through an alias; src-tauri/src/menu.rs builds the Mac menu bar from it). group is the menu an item is in; accel, when set, puts it there with that accelerator, so macOS cannot take the key first. Never give ⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘A or ⌘F an accelerator: text fields need them. The editor's own keys (⌘B, ⌘I, …) stay out: its toolbar shows them.
